means: THE v5r PACK'S PRE-KERNEL DECLARATIONS, as DATA. The framework entry scans this file synchronously (config.packs id -> packs/<id>/runtime.json) BEFORE createKernel, because the turn loop's reply-field table is a construction-time snapshot. Code hooks (sectionPolicy / noticeBlock) cannot live in JSON; the pack module exports them as PACK_CONTRIBUTION and the entry collects them when the module is loaded (the existing async pack-apply path) — so the entry names no pack and a third-party pack needs no entry edit.
